note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, a location pin, a key-words stack, one top text line, one key line and the end card, so 6 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: There's still good in the world.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: There's still good in the world. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:10 for 3 s, lower left, just above the caption box
mg.use: Put it on at 00:10 for 3 s. Move it lower left, just above the captions. Type the second line Mother of Jalen & Cody Williams under the name.

mg.title: Location pin
mg.cue: Location pin at 00:13 for 2 s, top left: Vista Colina Family Shelter
mg.use: Put it on at 00:13 for 2 s, top left, over the table B-roll.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words at 00:19, stacked in the top band as she says them: They are heard / We value them / Rooting and cheering
mg.use: Start at 00:19 so each phrase lands as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: without the TV, without the phone

mg.cue: Top text at 00:32 for 3 s, in the top band, as she says it: without the TV, without the phone
mg.use: Put it on at 00:32 as she says it, hold 3 s, top band.

mg.title: Key line

text.main: I hope that all the residents here feel the love from our table to theirs.

mg.cue: Key line in the top band, word by word as she says it: I hope that all the residents here feel the love from our table to theirs.
mg.use: Start at 01:02 with her words. Top band, captions stay on under it.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo in endcards/ yet (checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row; colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After her last line at 01:10. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
